operation: WorkspaceModelCacheImpl serializes and renames project-model-cache temporary file to cache.data
effect: Git operations completed but the acceptance gate rejected this run due to a SEVERE log entry
rootCause: Exact original serializer failure reproduced with a held ordinary reader or mapped target on bundled JBR. Bounded Windows retries recover short readers; persistent denial remains visible. The historical holding process was not captured and cannot be retrospectively attributed.

sourceInvestigation.finding: Atomic rename catches AtomicMoveNotSupportedException only; observed AccessDeniedException propagates from saveCacheToFile to the cache-saving coroutine. This locates the unhandled path but does not identify which handle or policy denied the operation.
sourceInvestigation.decision: Bounded Windows-only AccessDenied retries added only after exact original-interface reproduction; exhausted failure and interruption remain visible. Full same-ZIP regression in progress.
additionalFindings: Original failure occurred at JVM 2236ms during startup, before later Git update operations; it is not the newly fixed quick-shutdown queue invariant.

EntityStorageSerializerImpl.serializeCache closes KryoOutput in finally; KryoOutput.close uses FileChannel.use, and KryoInput.close explicitly cleans its mapped buffer. This does not identify the file handle or Windows policy causing the old rename denial.
No retry, log suppression, global antivirus exclusion or cache-disabling patch was added without reproduction.
